features: 空室は提供できる部屋がある状態、満室は空きがない状態
建物の絵の明るさではなく、予約可能な客室の有無を学ぶ
decision: Definitions are taught; the hotel artwork adds no separate quantitative rule.

features: 宿泊日・氏名・連絡先・人数
交通手段と到着予定
食事アレルギー
事前確認と来館予定の確認
decision: Six fields and the separate no-show/preparation paragraph reconciled. Attendance confirmation restored in this review.

features: 清潔な身だしなみ・姿勢・丁寧な言葉
予約の有無・氏名・人数・プラン
decision: Framed list transferred. Passport wording below the 1-go list remains subject to the existing current-rule correction, not copied literally.

features: 文化体験と訪日客の企画例
地域食材の食事と菜食条件の客の企画例
スイートルームと富裕層の企画例
矢印は例であり全員の希望や食事適合の保証ではない
decision: Three explicit pairings restored. The 2-go transport-registration paragraph is separate from the diagram and retains its existing legal-scope disposition.

features: 背筋・腹・あごと肩の力
腹より下で右手を下に重ねる
腕を横に下ろす資料例
2号のみ足のかかと・つま先の追加確認
decision: Front/side photos encode posture points already taught and assessed. They do not imply all genders must use one immutable pose.

features: 言葉を伝えてからおじぎ
会釈約15度、普通礼・敬礼約30度、最敬礼約45度
使用場面と角度を対応させる
decision: Angle is measured from vertical; controlled illustration computes the same hip-hinge inclinations. No source artwork reused.

features: 尊敬語は相手側の行動
謙譲語は自分側の行動
丁寧語は聞き手への丁寧な表現
予定外の要望は対応を考え、判断できなければ相談
decision: All three columns are taught. Learning illustration replaced to include polite language, which the old bitmap omitted.

features: 料理への指の接触・指紋を避ける
料理の正面は客側
料理は左・飲料は右という資料の基本
グラスの下半分を支え静かに置く
食文化は国や本人の条件により異なる
decision: Meal photographs introduce food-culture examples; no extra ingredient recipe or numerical condition is inferred from them.

features: 旬と一汁三菜
客側からご飯は左、汁は右
奥の副菜と主菜
三菜を三種の野菜や香の物だけと混同しない
decision: Corrected the learning diagram: three side-dish positions now show main dish and two side dishes; pickles no longer substitute for the third dish.

features: 前菜→椀盛→お造り→焼き物
煮物→揚物→酢の物
ご飯・香の物→水菓子
九枚の写真は左から右、次の行へ進む提供順
decision: Names and full nine-step order are taught and directly assessed. Source photos are not redistributed; realistic dish-identification practice is not certified by the written sequence question.
remaining: Practical identification of dishes from new original meal photographs is not accepted in this review.

features: 前菜・スープ・魚・肉・デザート・コーヒー
フォーク左、ナイフ・スプーン右、デザート用上、パン皿左上
外側から使用、右手ナイフ・左手フォーク
食事中のハの字と終了時の右下の並び
2号のバタースプレッダー
decision: Placement and both cutlery positions are now depicted. A new contrast question covers both signs; the old image only showed the place setting.
remaining: Realistic photo-based dish-identification is separate from name/order knowledge and is not certified here.
